checks.name: gui_files_exist
command: test -f Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h && test -f Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp && test -f Source/GUI/RotarySlider.h && test -f Source/GUI/RotarySlider.cpp && test -f Source/GUI/GoniometerComponent.h && test -f Source/GUI/GoniometerComponent.cpp && test -f Source/GUI/CorrelationMeter.h && test -f Source/GUI/CorrelationMeter.cpp && test -f Source/PluginEditor.h && test -f Source/PluginEditor.cpp && test -f CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: lookandfeel_popup_signature
command: rg -q 'drawPopupMenuItem' Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp && rg -q 'isSeparator' Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp && ! rg -q 'PopupMenu::Item' Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp

checks.name: goniometer_lissajous_math
command: rg -q 'GoniometerComponent' Source/GUI/GoniometerComponent.h && rg -n 'sqrt|Side|Mid|R - L|L \+ R|phosphor|alpha|AbstractFifo|hold' Source/GUI/GoniometerComponent.h Source/GUI/GoniometerComponent.cpp

checks.name: editor_layout_and_timer
command: rg -q 'GoniometerComponent' Source/PluginEditor.h Source/PluginEditor.cpp && rg -q 'CorrelationMeter' Source/PluginEditor.h Source/PluginEditor.cpp && rg -q 'CustomLookAndFeel' Source/PluginEditor.h Source/PluginEditor.cpp && rg -q 'timerCallback' Source/PluginEditor.h Source/PluginEditor.cpp && rg -q 'ResizableCornerComponent|setResizable' Source/PluginEditor.h Source/PluginEditor.cpp && rg -q 'SliderAttachment|AudioProcessorValueTreeState::SliderAttachment' Source/PluginEditor.h Source/PluginEditor.cpp

checks.name: cmake_registers_gui_sources
command: rg -q 'CustomLookAndFeel\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'RotarySlider\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'GoniometerComponent\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'CorrelationMeter\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'PluginEditor\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt
